description: Fixed inputs and outcomes for host adapters. File maps contain complete parsed JSON documents unless text is explicitly supplied. Missing file map entries are absent. Entry and line numbers are one-based. Local path facts are supplied OS-call results, not TypeScript canonicalization. All old-home examples use Decision 10/11 and fixed UTC time. For commit-state, lockBytes and catalogBytes are explicit UTF-8 writer outputs supplied by the test, not a required JSON serialization. Saved journal arrays must equal those bytes exactly; lock/catalog objects specify their decoded values.
